description: GTEx tissue expression of LPAL2 versus LPA and PLG, plus a three-panel figure summarising expression, the gene conversion test and cross-primate ORF status
code:
import requests, json, time, os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
s = requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent","Accept":"application/json"})

def gtex_tbl(sym):
    r=s.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/reference/gene", params={"geneId":sym}, timeout=120).json()
    gid=[d["gencodeId"] for d in r["data"] if d["geneSymbol"]==sym][0]
    rr=s.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
             params={"gencodeId":gid,"datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":100}, timeout=120).json()
    d=pd.DataFrame(rr["data"])[["tissueSiteDetailId","median"]].rename(columns={"median":sym})
    return gid, d

tabs={}; gids={}
for sym in ["LPAL2","LPA","PLG"]:
    g,d=gtex_tbl(sym); tabs[sym]=d; gids[sym]=g; time.sleep(1)
m=tabs["LPAL2"].merge(tabs["LPA"],on="tissueSiteDetailId").merge(tabs["PLG"],on="tissueSiteDetailId")
m=m.sort_values("LPAL2",ascending=False)
print("GTEx v8 median TPM (gencodeIds:", gids, ")")
print(m.head(12).to_string(index=False))
print("\nLiver row:"); print(m[m.tissueSiteDetailId=="Liver"].to_string(index=False))
liver=m[m.tissueSiteDetailId=="Liver"].iloc[0]
others=m[m.tissueSiteDetailId!="Liver"]
print(f"\nLPAL2: liver {liver.LPAL2:.2f} TPM vs median of other {len(others)} tissues {others.LPAL2.median():.3f} TPM"
      f" -> {liver.LPAL2/others.LPAL2.median():.1f} fold liver enrichment; max non-liver {others.LPAL2.max():.2f}"
      f" ({others.loc[others.LPAL2.idxmax(),'tissueSiteDetailId']})")
print(f"LPA  : liver {liver.LPA:.2f} TPM, max non-liver {others.LPA.max():.3f}")
print(f"PLG  : liver {liver.PLG:.2f} TPM, max non-liver {others.PLG.max():.3f}")

# ---------- figure: iteration 2 evidence ----------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(17,5.4))

# panel 1: GTEx liver specificity
top=m.head(12).set_index("tissueSiteDetailId")
x=np.arange(len(top)); w=0.27
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(x-w, top.LPAL2, w, color="#B3261E", label="LPAL2")
ax.bar(x,   top.LPA,   w, color="#1F6FEB", label="LPA")
ax.bar(x+w, top.PLG,   w, color="#2E7D32", label="PLG")
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylabel("GTEx v8 median TPM (log scale)")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([t.replace("_"," ") for t in top.index], rotation=55, ha="right", fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_title("A. LPAL2 is transcribed, and liver enriched like LPA and PLG", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# panel 2: gene conversion test
ax=axes[1]
labels=["human vs\nchimpanzee\nLPAL2","human vs\ngorilla\nLPAL2","human LPAL2 vs\nhuman LPA KIV-8\n(best paralogue)","human LPAL2 vs\nhuman PLG\nkringle 4"]
vals=[97.5,97.5,89.0,76.0]
cols=["#B3261E","#B3261E","#1F6FEB","#2E7D32"]
ax.bar(labels, vals, color=cols)
ax.set_ylim(60,100); ax.set_ylabel("nucleotide identity over the 237 nt kringle region (%)")
ax.set_title("B. Orthologues beat paralogues: no recent gene conversion", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i, v+0.4, f"{v:.1f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=7.5)
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# panel 3: cross-primate ORF status
ax=axes[2]
sp_order=["homo_sapiens","pan_troglodytes","pan_paniscus","gorilla_gorilla","pongo_abelii",
          "macaca_nemestrina","papio_anubis","cercocebus_atys","mandrillus_leucophaeus",
          "rhinopithecus_roxellana","callithrix_jacchus","cebus_imitator","carlito_syrichta",
          "otolemur_garnettii","prolemur_simus"]
status={"homo_sapiens":("TAG at codon 223",0),"pan_troglodytes":("TAG at codon 223",0),
 "pan_paniscus":("TAG at codon 223",0),"gorilla_gorilla":("TAG at codon 223",0),
 "pongo_abelii":("not aligned past exon 3",2),"macaca_nemestrina":("stop at codon 242 + frameshifts",1),
 "papio_anubis":("codon 223 deleted + frameshifts",1),"cercocebus_atys":("codon 223 deleted + frameshifts",1),
 "mandrillus_leucophaeus":("codon 223 deleted",1),"rhinopithecus_roxellana":("codon 223 deleted + frameshifts",1),
 "callithrix_jacchus":("stop at codon 192 + frameshifts",1),"cebus_imitator":("stop at codon 187 + frameshifts",1),
 "carlito_syrichta":("stop at codon 194",1),"otolemur_garnettii":("stop at codon 205",1),
 "prolemur_simus":("stop at codon 184",1)}
colmap={0:"#B3261E",1:"#E8A33D",2:"0.75"}
for i,spn in enumerate(sp_order):
    txt,c=status[spn]
    ax.barh(i, 1, color=colmap[c])
    ax.text(1.05, i, txt, va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sp_order))); ax.set_yticklabels([x.replace("_"," ") for x in sp_order], fontsize=8)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlim(0,3.4); ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_title("C. No primate carries an open LPAL2 frame past codon 242", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(0.02,-1.0,"red = identical premature TAG shared by African apes; amber = stop or frameshift elsewhere; grey = not alignable",
        fontsize=7.5, color="0.35")
for sp in ["top","right","bottom","left"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

out=os.getcwd()
m.to_csv(os.path.join(out,"LPAL2_GTEx_median_TPM.csv"), index=False)
print("\nsaved", os.path.join(out,"LPAL2_GTEx_median_TPM.csv"))
